title: ProQuant: Progressive Quantization-aware Training for Edge MLLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.08216v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) with impressive perception and understanding capabilities will enable a range of downstream applications. However, their substantial computational and memory requirements hinder the real-world implementation, particularly for resource-constrained edge devices. Quantization has emerged as an effective solution for deploying large models. While post-training quantization (PTQ) successfully retains the performance at moderate bit-width (e.g., W8A8), it suffers from severe performance degradation under low-bit quantization (e.g., W4A8), especially for small-scale models that are more suitable for edge deployment. In this paper, we propose ProQuant, a novel weight-activation quantization-aware training (QAT) framework tailored for low-bit MLLMs. First, to align the limited finetuning dataset distribution with the pretrained dataset distribution, we propose a self-relabeling (SRL) scheme to resample

translated_title: ProQuant：面向边缘多模态大模型的渐进式量化感知训练
translated_abstract: 具有出色感知和理解能力的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）将能够支持一系列下游应用。然而，其巨大的计算和内存需求阻碍了它们在现实世界中的实际部署，尤其是在资源受限的边缘设备上。量化已成为部署大模型的一种有效解决方案。虽然训练后量化（PTQ）在中等比特位宽（例如W8A8）下能够成功保持模型性能，但在低比特量化（例如W4A8）下会出现严重的性能退化，对于更适合边缘部署的小规模模型而言尤为明显。在本文中，我们提出了ProQuant，这是一种专为低比特MLLM量身定制的全新权重-激活量化感知训练（QAT）框架。首先，为了使有限的微调数据集分布与预训练数据集分布对齐，我们提出了一种自重标记（SRL）方案来重新采样……
tldr: 本文提出了ProQuant，一个专为低比特多模态大语言模型设计的渐进式权重-激活量化感知训练框架，通过自重标记（SRL）方案对齐微调数据与预训练数据的分布，显著缓解了边缘小规模模型在低比特量化下的严重性能退化问题。
en_tdlr: ProQuant is a novel progressive weight-activation quantization-aware training (QAT) framework tailored for low-bit multimodal large language models, which mitigates severe performance degradation under low-bit quantization on edge devices via a self-relabeling (SRL) scheme that aligns limited finetuning data distribution with the pretrained data distribution.
